page.content:
The collaborative encyclopedia — policies, projects, and knowledge-graph culture.

How Wikipedia connects

  • Work: English Wikipedia — English Wikipedia is the original language edition of the project.
  • Character: Jimmy Wales — Jimmy Wales co-founded Wikipedia and remained its most public advocate.
  • Character: Larry Sanger — Larry Sanger proposed the wiki feeder and named Wikipedia.
  • Work: Nupedia — Nupedia preceded Wikipedia and was meant to receive its drafts.
  • Topic: Wiki — The wiki pattern is the editing model Wikipedia scaled to an encyclopedia.
  • Item: MediaWiki — MediaWiki is the software that still serves Wikipedia pages.
  • Faction: Wikimedia Foundation — The Wikimedia Foundation hosts and fundraises for Wikipedia.
  • Topic: Wikipedian — Wikipedians are the volunteer editors who write the encyclopedia.
  • Work: Nupedia — Wikipedia overtook and outlived the Nupedia review process.
  • Item: CC BY-SA — Wikipedia text is licensed under CC BY-SA so others can reuse it.
  • Item: UseModWiki — UseModWiki ran Wikipedia before MediaWiki replaced it.
  • Faction: Bomis — Bomis also hosted Wikipedia until the Wikimedia Foundation formed.

What is Wikipedia?

Wikipedia is the free encyclopedia anyone can edit, launched in 2001 as a feeder for Nupedia and then overtaking it. Its lore is policies, language editions, the Wikimedia Foundation, and a citation culture that treats verifiability as the product.

Key threads lead to English Wikipedia, Jimmy Wales, Larry Sanger, Nupedia, Wiki and MediaWiki.
